name: Beta
verdict: Beta Group, a company of the Ciceri family with TIP as co-shareholder. Nothing found.
note: MotoGP partner of SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team per trackhouse.com/partners (checked 2026-10-03 via Wayback Machine), and technical partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team. Ownership (gruppo-beta.com): Italian family company of the Ciceri family, led by Roberto Ciceri, founder's great-grandson; TIP (Tamburi Investment Partners) co-shareholder since 2016 (beta-ciceri-ownership). No state stake and no human-rights finding found (checked 2026-10-03).
